answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 13327 Country: Canada Title: I work as a mortgage broker in canada. It means that i arrange financing for people who want to buy a house but do not have money and i arrange loan for them from bank and i get commission from the bank. This loan involves interest which the client has to pay to the bank. Is this kind of job allowed in islam or should i change the job and is my earnings halal. Please explain in detail. Question: I work as a mortgage broker in canada. It means that i arrange financing for people who want to buy a house but do not have money and i arrange loan for them from bank and i get commission from the bank. This loan involves interest which the client has to pay to the bank. Is this kind of job allowed in islam or should i change the job and is my earnings halal. Please explain in detail. Answer ID: 13327 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 947/889=B/1430) It is sinful and unlawful, you should look for any other job. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
